note: Five signed sections of the Teaberry trailhead parking lot, a long gravel lot (about 150 m by 25 m on imagery) beside paved Cold Springs Road, entered at its south end: 'Campsites will be delineated with signs in the parking area. Please use only your defined section.' Open, in full sun, level and easy to get a rig into; rigs park in a row along the lot. It is a trailhead for the forest's equestrian trails, so the lot is shared with day-use parking and horse trailers; each site has a hitching post and a stone fire ring. One of the four Michaux areas kept open through the winter camping season (third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1); forest roads get no winter maintenance. No toilet; pack out trash. --Claude
summary: All five site pages re-read (021A-021E): listed and bookable online, Drive-In, Horse/RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 45 ft, pull-through, gravel; no ATV, 4WD or 'not recommended' text. Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking, hookups, site count and year-round season (a designated winter site) confirmed; toilets/water written as none. Imagery: long gravel lot with four rigs parked along it, pin on the lot. NHD: no water within 200 m. Phone 717-352-2211 confirmed.
